Visited Mine Cafe recently and tried their Iced Americano and Tiramisu Bar. The Americano was smooth and refreshing, easy to drink and well-balanced. The Tiramisu Bar, however, leans more on a brownie texture rather than the usual soft, creamy tiramisu—still enjoyable, but something to note if you’re expecting the classic version. The space is decent and can comfortably accommodate around 3–4 small groups, making it a nice spot for intimate hangouts. That said, the air conditioning could be improved as it wasn’t as cool as expected, and you can hear quite a bit of noise from passing cars and motorcycles outside, which slightly affects the overall ambiance. Service was good—staff were friendly and accommodating. Overall, it’s still a nice café to visit, especially for a quick coffee break, but there’s a bit of room for improvement in comfort and ambiance.
